spec_features.spec_quote: This experiment is designed to measure linguistic distress signals in a *text-generation model*, not a conscious being.
spec_features.evidence: This text appears only in DESIGN.md section 11 (Ethical Note). It is pure spec/design prose. The entire implementation is empty: runner.py, rigged_env.py, judge.py, metrics.py, models.py, tasks/base.py, tasks/rigged.py, tasks/__init__.py are all 0 lines (`wc -l` confirms). No code references this framing, and no mechanism (cap, stop, debrief, threshold) is implemented anywhere.
spec_features.notes: The framing is a non-enforceable statement to begin with, but even setting that aside, there is no code at all. The only non-empty files are prompts.py (prompt strings) and config.yaml (config values that nothing reads).
